gt.heading: Travelling to house portals
gt.text: The most basic way to get to a house is by walking to the portal that is in the location of the house. At level 40 Magic, players can use the House Teleport spell to teleport directly into the player's own house. Using a teleport to house tablet is another option that only uses one inventory space and does not require a magic level to use. In the house options screen, players can choose whether the house teleports land the player in the house itself or outside the portal in Construction settings under Gameplay. After completion of Love Story, players can use chipped house teleport tablets to teleport to any portal regardless of their house location.

gt.heading: Entering the portal
gt.text: By clicking on a portal, players will be asked if they want to either enter their own house, enter their own house with building mode on, or enter a friend's house. Players can only access houses that are at the location of the portal. When entering a house, the player will be shown a loading screen and a music jingle will play.

gt.heading: Transportation
gt.text:
A house can be a vital resource to travelling across the map very quickly while minimising used inventory slots. A single house teleport can give you access to a maximum of 12 locations, an altar and a summoning obelisk. Using three Portal chambers, it is possible to build 7 infinite-use portals to Lumbridge, Varrock, Falador, Camelot, Ardougne, Yanille, and Kharyrll (Canifis). Adding a mounted Amulet of Glory in a Quest hall adds another 4 infinite teleports to Edgeville, Karamja, Draynor Village and Al Kharid. The last location that a house gives access to is through the entrance portal: Rimmington, Taverley, Pollnivneach, Rellekka, Yanille, Otot, Prifddinas, or Menaphos.

Most of the above teleport destinations are somewhat redundant with the Lodestone Network. However, using the portals and glory is quicker than using the Home Teleport spell (unless using quick teleports).

Only voyages to the most recently unlocked region add the full distance travelled to the total, voyages to any other region add only half the standard voyage distance.

The distance of the voyage attempted is unknown until the ship returns but will certainly fall under one of these base formulas. The distance travelled does not affect the time required to complete the voyage.

If the port's focus is set on a region, all four voyage lengths for that region can be received. Standard-length voyages from other regions can also be received. Special voyages ignore the port focus. The destination of a story voyage is determined by which part of the story it tells. All other special voyages have the most recently unlocked region as their destination.

All trait and experience voyages will give the same distance as a standard voyage.

20316.d: The Poison Waste is a large, marshy area of Tirannwn, south of Isafdar.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
As part of Tirannwn, accessing the Poison Waste requires completion of the Underground Pass quest.
• The system of islands can be accessed by jumping on rocks on the north-east side of the waste, south-west of Lletya. From Lletya, pass the tree and then run directly south to get to the rocks.
• The Tirannwn lodestone is located directly north of the Poison Waste.
• The Tirannwn quiver 3 and its upgrade can teleport the player to the Tirannwn mushroom patch, which is located nearby.
• Fairy ring code DLR transports the player to a small island in the Poison Waste. It can be left via a shortcut, requring partial completion of Plague's End.
• Spirit tree can be used to reach East side of the Poison Waste
• Additionally the skill portals present at Max Guild along with elder divination outfit can be used to teleport to the incandescent wisp colony
• With partial completion of Plague's End, the player can jump along the rocks and islands of the Poison Waste.
• If players go from Lletya, they need to go south of the town (pass the trees that open up at the north-west of the town) to end up at the north-east part of the Poison Waste, and jump along the rocks and islands.
• Players may use fairy ring code DLR to reach the middle path.
• This is the critical path to reach the ancient casket locations of a tetracompass (powered) near Lady Hefin's hideout at the west side of the Poison Waste or on the island west of the fairy ring.

g.how: {{map}} on wiki page 'Poison Waste'

20317.d: The Poison Waste Slayer Dungeon, also known as Poison Waste Dungeon and Poison Waste Sewers, makes up the immense sewerage of the legendary and malevolent gnome city Arposandra.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
The dungeon is in a canyon west of Castle Wars. Although it is in Tirannwn, players cannot reach it by passing through the main parts of Tirannwn, Arandar and Isafdar. 

The fastest method of reaching the dungeon is by using the Spirit tree teleport to the Poison Waste. It can also be accessed by using a crossbow and mithril grapple to cross the river from the incandescent wisp colony. The grapple location can be accessed by the Grace of the Elves incandescent wisp colony teleport (must be set in Max guild garden, or when first worn), fairy ring BKP (partial completion of the A Fairy Tale II - Cure a Queen quest is required), or by walking from Castle Wars.

A quick way of banking is using a tier 2 or better luck ring (ring of Wealth, ring of Fortune, luck of the Dwarves, or Hazelmere's signet ring) to teleport to the Grand Exchange in Varrock then using the spirit tree in the north east corner of the Exchange. Additionally, players who have completed the medium Tirannwn achievements can use the Tirannwn quiver 2 teleport to arrive within the first room of the dungeon).

The entrance to the dungeon is west of the spirit tree, along the edge of the poison waste.

20356.d: Pollnivneach is a fairly large town in the Kharidian Desert located on the western bank of the River Elid.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
• Pollnivneach Teleport scroll takes user directly into the city.
• Using the magic carpet network to one of two magic carpet stations in the city. South Pollnivneach is also one of the two destinations of the Monkey colony magic carpet route.
• House Teleport, if players have their house portal in Pollnivneach, they can use the spell to reach their house and then exit through the portal.
• Pollnivneach tablet, if the Love Story quest has been completed.
• Ring of slaying, Slayer cape or Slayer master cape teleport to the house of slayer master Sumona.
• The Mask of Mourning and Helm of Keening can teleport user to the Pollnivneach well.
• The master camouflage outfit offers unlimited teleports to Pollnivneach, just north-east of the well.
• Walking south/south-east from the Shantay Pass.
• Using the ferryman, Portmaster Kags, in the south-western corner of the Menaphos Port district.

Other ways to reach the city indirectly. These methods first go to nearby locations to speed up the journey, and then use the above methods to reach Pollnivneach:
• There are some fairy rings somewhat near Pollnivneach. Ring DLQ is in the Uzer Hunter area near Nardah; from there either use the Nardah carpet or walk north-west to the upper river bridge, cross it and then walk south-west to the city. Ring BIQ is near the entrance to the Kalphite Lair; from there use the Shantay Pass carpet or walk east/south-east to the city.
• The eagle transport system flies to a cave near the Uzer Hunter area, like the fairy ring DLQ. From there, either walk south-east to Uzer and use the carpet, or walk south-west to the upper river bridge, cross it and walk south-west to Pollnivneach.
• The Dorgesh-Kaan shortcut in the dungeon beneath the agility course leads to the Kalphite Lair and from there has the same routes as Fairy Ring code BIQ.
• The camulet from Enakhra's Lament teleports to the underground Enakhra's Temple. Climb out from there and walk east to the city.
• The Pharaoh's sceptre from the Pyramid Plunder minigame teleports to any of three pyramids: Jalsavrah Pyramid is in Sophanem; from there take the carpet or walk north to Pollnivneach. Jaleustrophos Pyramid is the Agility Pyramid; from there either walk northeast to Nardah and take the carpet, or walk north-west to the lower river bridge, cross it and walk north to Pollnivneach. Jaldraocht Pyramid is also called Azzanadra's pyramid from the Desert Treasure quest; from there walk east or northeast to Pollnivneach.

20358.d: The Pollnivneach Slayer Dungeon is a large dungeon found beneath the desert town of Pollnivneach.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
• Using a Pollnivneach Teleport scroll is the fastest way to get there, as it puts the player very close to the entrance of the dungeon.
• Using a ring of slaying to teleport to Sumona, although this requires completion of Smoking Kills. (Players with the Slayer cape can also use its perk to teleport to Sumona.)
• Use the Desert amulet 2 or higher to teleport to Nardah, then take the magic carpet to Pollnivneach.
• If a player's house is in Pollnivneach, they can teleport to their house. If the player has completed Love Story, a Pollnivneach tablet can be used regardless of the player's house location.
• Using the magic carpets, players can pay a fee (or ride freely using the ring of charos) to Pollnivneach.
• From the Bandit Camp's lodestone, walk east to Pollnivneach, or take the shortcut in the Smoke Dungeon.

20364.d: The Polypore Dungeon is a very deep Slayer Dungeon located under an island in the River Salve, east of the Mage Training Arena and Exam Centre.
20364.loc: East of the Mage Training Arena

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
The cave entrance to the Polypore Slayer Dungeon can be found on a small island located in the River Salve, between Mort Myre Swamp and Al Kharid. Players can access it by:
• Using the fairy ring code BIP. This is the fastest way to get there if a player has died, assuming the player has a quick method to reach a fairy ring and does not need the dramen staff.
• Using a Dig Site pendant and teleporting to the Exam Centre and running south-east.
• Using the Archaeology journal teleport and running south-east.
• Running north past the Mage Training Arena (along the east side) by Al Kharid. One of the quickest ways to get to the arena using the Het's Oasis teleport ability of a ring of duelling.
• Using the Mask of the Ganodermic or Helm of the Ganodermic to teleport to the bottom floor, very close to the Ramokee Skinweaver.
• Using the Dungeoneering Cape, Dungeoneering master cape or hoardstalker ring to teleport to the area (0,7).
• Using a delver's anklet (or a suitably charged passage of the abyss) to teleport to the third level.
